parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: Extensions
parameters.description: The extensions that you want to update. Separate multiple extensions with commas (,).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb upgrade-extensions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --extensions citext,dblink --database-name test01 --region cn-hangzhou
